question: Should crabpot adopt the refactored qqbot revision after repairing or approving the isolated fixture difference, or defer this dependency bump until upstream compatibility is clearer?
rationale: The pointer imports broad upstream execution and installation changes, and the targeted fixture fails without enough diagnostic detail to distinguish an intentional expectation change from an incompatible plugin revision.

options.title: Hold and investigate
options.body: Inspect the failed fixture and upstream diff, update expectations only for intentional output changes, and require passing source-mode and package-mode smoke checks before merge.

options.title: Accept documented compatibility risk
options.body: Merge only after a maintainer records why the fixture failure is expected and confirms the installer and runtime changes are safe for this repository.

options.title: Defer the bump
options.body: Close or pause this update and wait for a narrower or better-proven upstream revision if the refactor is not yet compatible.

recommendation.title: Hold and investigate
recommendation.body: Inspect the failed fixture and upstream diff, update expectations only for intentional output changes, and require passing source-mode and package-mode smoke checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidence-backed person directly connected to the central upstream architecture rewrite, though target-repository merge authority is not established.
